The tests use a {@link MockRandom} (EvoSuite's d
ADDED i9: A null salt makes apr1Crypt generate one itself (deterministic here because of the mocked randomness).
ADDED i10: The supplied salt "WU04K" is echoed back in the "$apr1$<salt>$..." hash.
ADDED i11: The salt is derived from the provided Random instance.
ADDED i12: The deprecated public constructor still works.
ADDED i13: md5Crypt produces a "$1$" prefixed hash.
ADDED i14: A self-generated salt is used when only the key is supplied.
ADDED i15: A self-generated salt is used; the result carries the "$1$" prefix.
